discourse.title: Prick the bubble of pride
discourse.excerpt: True to his word, Arjuna lit a fire and was about to expiate for the sin of pride that made him feel superior to Rama, when Krishna appeared and asked the reason, as if He did not know! In fact, that was the very reason why He appeared!
discourse.theme: Pride makes us feel superior even to the Lord; humility restores us.

reflection: How do I know pride has crept into me? Arjuna's pride showed up as comparison — 'I could have built a better bridge than Rama.' Whenever you measure yourself against someone else, the bubble is inflating. Swami's remedy is instant: the moment Arjuna's pride was humbled, he fell at Hanuman's feet. Bow — in your heart, before the day ends — and the bubble pops.

video.title: Even wife and son are disgusted by a man with ego | Sri Sathya Sai Speaks | Aug 25, 1998

seva_nudge: Let someone else take the credit for one thing today — and smile about it.
